title: A1 Swaara v1.0.3 - Android 16 Background & Media Button Stability Fix
changelog:
- Fixed ForegroundServiceDidNotStartInTimeException on Android 14/15/16 when receiving media button broadcasts, connecting Bluetooth headsets, or waking from background
- Added synchronous foreground service dispatch in ServiceNotifications without main looper queue delay
- Added guaranteed standby foreground notification and onStartCommand lifecycle handling even before songs are loaded into the player
- Prevented invincibility loops when player queue is empty
- Verified 12.81 MB R8-optimized release package
